meta.name: squeeze-page-builder
meta.description: Build email capture landing pages (squeeze pages) as single self-contained HTML files. Triggers on: "build a squeeze page", "email capture page", "lead magnet page", "create an opt-in page", "build an email list page", "lead capture landing page", "create a freebie page", "build a page to collect emails", "opt-in landing page", "email signup page for [product/niche]", "create a lead magnet landing page", "build a page that captures emails before sending to affiliate offer".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成用于收集邮件的独立HTML落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想通过落地页获取潜在客户邮件
copy.tagline_en: Build standalone HTML squeeze pages to capture emails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to capture leads with a squeeze page

howto.what: 当您要求构建一个“squeeze page”（电子邮件捕获页）时，Claude 会生成一个自包含的 HTML 文件。页面包含一个提供免费资源（如清单、电子书）以换取邮箱的表单，提交后重定向到您的联盟链接。
howto.when: 当您提到“build a squeeze page”、“email capture page”、“lead magnet page”等关键词，或要求创建一个用于收集邮箱的页面时触发。
howto.what_en: When you ask to build a squeeze page, Claude generates a self-contained HTML file with an email form offering a free resource (e.g., checklist, ebook) and redirects to your affiliate link on submission.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "build a squeeze page", "email capture page", "lead magnet page", or similar phrases requesting an email collection page.

say_en.text: Build a squeeze page offering a free SEO checklist.
say_en.note: Generates a page with a checklist lead magnet.

say_en.text: Create an email capture page for a free template pack, redirect to my affiliate link.
say_en.note: Creates a template pack capture page redirecting to your affiliate link.

say_en.text: Generate a lead magnet page for a free cheat sheet, with a blue theme.
say_en.note: Generates a blue-themed cheat sheet capture page.
